items.wordHook: 台(Taiwan) + 北(north) → Taipei, the northern city of Taiwan.

Draw back a bent hunting 弓(bow) along the straight vertical 丨(line) of the bowstring to 引(pull).
a 忄(heart) stands still and turns 白(white) as shadows close in → making you 怕(be scared of).
旅(journey) + 行(go) → to go on a journey, to travel.
Settlers migrate to 殖(breed) and settle as 民(citizens) upon foreign 地(earth): 殖民地 means colony.
Pour your intention (注) into the meaning (意) → that's paying attention.
Choosing to 看(look) down on someone with 不(no) respect to lift them 起(begin): 看不起 means despise, look down on.
a 車(cart) skims over the 巠(underground river) → 輕(light).
